paragraphs.text: The Haunt of Hightower is a legendary Moroii vampire from Ravnica .

The Haunt of Hightower is a Moroii , a psionic vampire who drains the vitality of those it touches for sustenance, that inhabits an area known as Hightower on the plane. It has the appearance of a humanoid bat with large leathery wings, a muscular, monstrous body, and sharp claws for hands. It has some tattered purple clothing around its body, and purple light glows from its veins, mouth, and eyes.
